summary: Keep DSL discovery within the selected repository

delivery.outcome: Repository DSL validation does not discover duplicate manifests from nested checkouts or operational recovery storage.
nonGoals: Change workspace auditing or approval rules
Migrate downstream repositories before upstream publication

architecture.decision: Keep recursive discovery bounded to its explicitly selected repository; explicit targets retain independent validation.
interfaceChanges: Directory discovery stops at nested Git checkout boundaries and reserved operational storage.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded discovery change and matching checker artifact digest through protected publication.

validation.evidence: Built-in discovery regression cases run in the existing Linux, Windows and container verification lanes.
